faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do my members need to install an app?
faq.a1: No store download. FightBase opens in the browser, so members just follow your link. On iPhone, add it to the Home Screen to get notifications.
faq.q2: How do members join my club?
faq.a2: You share a link or a class code. Members open the link or enter the code, join, and then see your classes, announcements and their membership.
faq.q3: Does FightBase take payments from my members?
faq.a3: No. Members pay you directly, for example in cash, by bank transfer or with your own card terminal. In FightBase you mark who has paid and see who hasn't and whose card ends soon. FightBase never holds that money or takes a share of it.
faq.q4: How do I get started as a coach?
faq.a4: Sign up, set up your club, add your classes and price list, then share your link or class code with members. You run all of it from your phone.
faq.q5: Which sports and languages does it support?
faq.a5: Boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, BJJ, kickboxing, wrestling, judo, karate and sambo. FightBase works in Estonian, Russian and English.
faq.q6: What can my members do in the app?
faq.a6: They see your class schedule, read your announcements, message you, sign up for camps and check their own membership, all from their phone.
